Name: Last Harvest
Combat Ability: Cleave: hits every zombie in the swing arc
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Execute: instantly kills zombies below 25% HP; Kills restore 3 stamina
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Shamblers and Lurchers (1 in 1,000)
Unique Look: A farmer's scythe with a moon-pale blade, a snath of weathered barn oak, and a braid of wheat tied below the grip that never rots.
Flavor Text: Somebody kept bringing the harvest in after the end. They never found the farmer, just the rows cut clean and the dead lying in them.

Name: Hush
Passive: Silent kills: kills do not alert nearby zombies
Combat Ability: Crits cause Bleed: 8 dmg/s for 4 s
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Every kill grants +20% movement speed for 3 s; Parry: 10% chance to negate an incoming melee hit
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Stalker zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: A soot-black kukri with a felt-wrapped handle and a blade that swallows light, so it never glints in the dark.
Flavor Text: Taken off the first Stalker anyone managed to kill. Nobody knows whose it was before. The Stalker had been carrying it for a long time.

Name: Brute Force
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Every 4th hit stuns for 1.5 s; Each kill heals 3 HP
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Brute zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: Oversized iron knuckles hammered from a truck hitch, wrapped in boxing tape, with BRUTE scratched across the four rings.
Flavor Text: Pried off a Brute's hand after the longest fight of somebody's life. The fingers had grown around it.

Name: Shieldbreaker
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Shockwave: heavy attacks deal 50% damage in a 2-tile radius; Stun 1 s on every hit
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Riot zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: A police breaching ram cut down into a two-handed hammer, still stenciled POLICE, with a riot visor bolted on as a hand guard.
Flavor Text: Built to open doors that did not want to open. It turns out armor is just a door somebody is wearing.

Name: Hunting Bow
Base Trait: Arrows 60% recoverable; Stealth shots deal triple damage
How to Obtain: Hunting lodges, ranger stations, cabins

Name: Ash Hunting Bow
Base Trait: Arrows 60% recoverable; Stealth shots deal triple damage
How to Obtain: Locked hunting cabinets; or Hunting Bow + Ranged Upgrade Kit

Name: Wooden Boomerang
Base Trait: Returns to your hand; light stagger
How to Obtain: Toy stores, kids' rooms, summer camps

Name: Steel Boomerang
Base Trait: Returns to your hand; light stagger
How to Obtain: Uncommon loot; or Wooden Boomerang + Ranged Upgrade Kit

Name: Razor Boomerang
Base Trait: Returns to your hand; light stagger
Combat Ability: Piercing: passes through up to 3 zombies
How to Obtain: Craft: Steel Boomerang + Saw Blade x2

Name: Comet
Base Trait: Returns to your hand; light stagger
Combat Ability: Piercing: passes through every zombie in its path
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Bleed: 5 dmg/s for 3 s; Seeking: locks onto the nearest zombie
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Runner zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: A boomerang cut from a jet-black wing panel, edged in polished steel, with a streak of orange paint like a comet tail.
Flavor Text: A kid's toy that kept coming back long after the kid didn't. The Runners chased it. Now it chases them.

Name: Bile Sling
Combat Ability: Corrosive: 5 dmg/s for 5 s and -20% zombie armor
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Explodes on impact (1-tile radius); Corroded zombies take +25% damage
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Spitter zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: A slingshot grown over with green glassy crust, its band replaced with a stretched Spitter throat that still twitches.
Flavor Text: Somebody figured out the Spitters' acid sacs keep working after they die. Nobody has volunteered to figure out why.

Name: Cinderheart
Base Trait: Flare lures zombies to the impact point for 10 s; small burn
Bonus Abilities (Legendary): Explodes on impact (2-tile radius); Burning zombies take +25% damage
How to Obtain: Very rare drop from Charred zombies (1 in 300)
Unique Look: A three-shot flare launcher with a blackened brass drum and a heat-cracked grip that glows red from the inside.
Flavor Text: Found in the hand of a Charred that used to be a fire captain. It was still loaded, as if he had meant to signal someone.
